texts.label: text
texts.orig: The Falcon-VT1 is a flight controller board for small VTOL fixed-wing UAVs, supporting up to 8 independent ESC channels, redundant IMUs, and a dedicated telemetry radio link. It is designed to drive the four thrust-generating devices used in tail-sitting VTOL transitions.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The flight controller MCU fuses IMU, GPS, and barometric data at 400 Hz and outputs PWM/DShot commands to the ESC driver bank. The RF transceiver provides a bidirectional 915 MHz telemetry link to the ground control station for command uplink and status downlink.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The current revision (A2) does not provide hot-swap redundancy between the primary and secondary IMU; a failed primary IMU requires a reboot to switch. This is being addressed in Rev. B.
